data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root sh-d-q meaning ‘to be truthful’ or ‘to speak the truth’. Mushaddiq signifies one who is truthful and sincere, a person of integrity and honesty. The name Mushaddiq carries the meaning “Truthful, sincere” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mushaddiq usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful, sincere and live with faith, good character and purpose.
